question: Add the terms events and sessions to the free_tier.unit vocabulary, and web (a browser dashboard with no API) and sdk (data in through client libraries only) to the interface vocabulary? The new records use requests or mixed for counts of events, sessions and beats (Statsig, Aptabase, Phare, Umami Cloud and Drumbeats use requests; Amplitude, Mixpanel, Heap, Hotjar, Middleware, Bugfender, Checkly and OnlineOrNot use mixed) and unknown for free plans reached only through a browser dashboard or an SDK (Pulsetic, UptimeObserver, StatusCake, Umami Cloud, Hotjar, Aptabase, Bugfender, Middleware).
why: A value that fits no term of a vocabulary extends it (a rules session adds the term); until then the true term is named in each record's text and the nearest term is used.
